name: Arcane Mafia
source:
You've just ingested enough magic drug to kill 12.5 elephants – and now the magical mafia want their merchandise back. 

You'll have to kiss your way out of this one before they abraca-kill-ya!

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
你刚刚摄入了足以杀死12.5头大象的神奇药物，现在神奇的黑手党想要拿回他们的商品。

在他们用阿布拉卡杀死你之前，你必须亲吻才能摆脱这个困境！

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用程序[/url]]
